basics.name: Anass Benomar
basics.title: Full Stack Developer
basics.summary: Full Stack Developer with experience in building, optimizing, and maintaining enterprise-grade applications. Experienced in building robust business features using Spring Boot, Angular, SQL, and REST APIs, as well as conducting deep-dive incident investigations, executing root cause analysis (RCA), and collaborating across cross-functional development and operations teams to ensure high application availability.

work.position: Full Stack Developer and DevOps Engineer

projects.name: Transport Hub – Vehicle Management App
projects.description: Enterprise web application for fleet and transport operations
highlights: Built application features using Spring Boot, Angular, and PrimeNG that enabled vehicle tracking, fleet management, real-time location updates and availability calendar.
Resolved cross-stack defects in the frontend and backend layers, ensuring application reliability and user workflows.

projects.name: TIM AM – TIM BUSINESS
projects.description: Junior DevOps Engineer responsibilities within NTT DATA
highlights: Monitored production systems, investigated incidents using Kibana and application logs to identify root causes, and collaborated with infrastructure and development teams to restore service quickly.
Managed containerized applications on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) using Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), monitoring and troubleshooting services to maintain high system availability.
Performed infrastructure maintenance, including SSL certificate renewals, cache management, and file system optimization, to ensure uninterrupted service.
Executed and maintained CI/CD deployments for backend microservices through Jenkins pipelines, ensuring deployment reliability.
Deployed Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) applications using CRX Package Manager to seamlessly roll out targeted application and digital content updates.
Designed and developed a standalone Java desktop automation tool that extracted Excel reports, cutting manual daily and weekly reporting effort for the team.

projects.name: Kafaa'at – Employee Management App
projects.description: Internal employee and project management platform
highlights: Developed employee profile, project tracking, and resource pool management modules using Spring Boot, Angular, and PrimeNG, delivering responsive and mobile-friendly user interfaces.
Investigated and resolved full-stack defects across frontend and backend layers, improving application reliability and streamlining user workflows.
Managed Flyway database migrations, evolving relational database schemas to support new business requirements while ensuring data integrity.
Increased backend unit test coverage to over 80% using JUnit and Mockito, reducing regression risks and improving code quality before production releases.

projects.name: CV APP – Resume Management Application
projects.description: Resume data transformation and persistence module
highlights: Designed a normalized database schema and UML entity model to ensure consistent storage of employee profiles and qualifications.
Implemented Java functionality to persist resume data, enabling employees to generate standardized Europass resumes.
